title: Speechius
claim: Product Hunt: Speechius — The teleprompter that actually listens
why_good: A teleprompter that follows your voice and scrolls as you speak — a real, specific improvement for creators and speakers.
value: Prosumer subscription for creators, execs and educators; voice-following is a concrete upgrade people pay for.
risk: Small niche and easily cloned; existing teleprompter apps can add voice-tracking.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Speechius —— 真正会听的提词器。
zh.why_good: 一个跟着你的声音滚动的提词器——对创作者和演讲者是真实、具体的改进。
